source.english_context: Unit 19 Taxis, Rideshares, and Airport Trips Goal: get a ride safely, confirm the destination, and handle pickup problems. Daily Life English Can you take me to this address? Are you my driver? Can you wait two minutes? Please drop me off at this entrance. Where is the rideshare pickup area? What is the license plate number? I am standing near the blue sign. How long will it take to reach the airport? Does the fare include tolls? Could you open the trunk, please? I have one suitcase and a backpack. Could you turn the air conditioning down? Please stop at the next safe place. Can I get a receipt for the ride? I think I left my phone in your car. Vocabulary taxi a car you pay to take you somewhere rideshare a ride booked through an app pickup spot the place where the driver meets you drop-off the place where the driver leaves you license plate the number on the car fare the cost of the ride destination the place you are traveling to trunk the storage space at the back of a car toll a charge for using a road or bridge meter a device that calculates the price of a taxi ride terminal a building at an airport where passengers arrive and leave estimated arrival time the time someone expects to reach a place US Customs For app rides, check the car, license plate, and driver's name before getting in. At airports, rideshare pickup may be in a special area, not directly outside baggage claim. Use the app or meter price. Be careful if a stranger offers a private ride inside the airport. Confirm the destination before the trip starts, especially when several nearby buildings or streets have similar names in the app. Ask where to wait if the pickup area is crowded. Describe a visible sign or entrance to help the driver find you. If you need help with luggage, ask politely and explain which bags belong to you. Keep the pickup area clear. Before leaving the car, check the seat and floor for your belongings. Keep the trip receipt for later questions. Dialogue Student: Hi, are you Daniel? Driver: Yes. Are you going to 18 Maple Road? Student: Yes, please. Can you drop me off at the front entrance? Driver: Sure. It will take about 20 minutes. Student: Thank you. I have two bags. Driver: There is room in the trunk. Would you like some help? Student: Yes, please. The larger bag is quite heavy. Driver: No problem. Is the front entrance beside the pharmacy? Student: That is right. The door has a blue sign above it. Driver: Thanks for confirming. I know which entrance you mean.

japanese_explanation.heading: 乗る前に車と行き先を確認
points: 配車アプリでは、乗る前に運転手の名前、車種、ナンバープレートを確認します。
空港ではタクシーや配車の乗り場が決まっていることがあります。案内表示に従いましょう。
知らない人から空港内で直接ライドを勧められたら注意します。公式のタクシー乗り場やアプリを使う方が安全です。

existing_simplified_chinese.heading: 上车前确认车和目的地
points: 使用网约车App时，上车前要确认司机姓名、车型和车牌号。
机场的出租车或网约车通常有指定上车区，不一定在行李提取处门口。
如果陌生人在机场里面主动拉客，要小心。使用正式出租车区或App更安全。

ko.heading: 탑승 전 차량 및 목적지 확인
points: 승차 공유 앱을 이용하는 경우, 탑승 전에 운전자의 이름, 차량 종류, 차량 번호판을 확인하세요.
공항에서는 택시나 승차 공유 차량의 승차 장소가 지정되어 있을 수 있습니다. 안내 표지판을 따르세요.
공항 내부에서 낯선 사람이 직접 탑승을 권유하면 주의하세요. 공식 택시 승차장이나 앱을 이용하는 것이 더 안전합니다.

es.heading: Confirme el vehículo y el destino antes de subir
points: Al usar una aplicación de viaje compartido, confirme el nombre del conductor, el modelo del auto y la matrícula antes de subir.
En los aeropuertos, las zonas de recogida de taxis o viajes compartidos pueden estar designadas. Siga las señales.
Tenga cuidado si un desconocido le ofrece un viaje directamente dentro del aeropuerto. Es más seguro usar las paradas de taxis oficiales o la aplicación.

pt-BR.heading: Confirme o veículo e o destino antes de embarcar
points: Ao usar um aplicativo de transporte, confirme o nome do motorista, o modelo do carro e a placa antes de entrar.
Em aeroportos, os locais de embarque de táxis ou carros de aplicativo podem ser designados. Siga as sinalizações.
Tenha cuidado se um estranho oferecer uma corrida diretamente dentro do aeroporto. É mais seguro usar pontos de táxi oficiais ou o aplicativo.

fr.heading: Avant de monter, confirmez le véhicule et la destination
points: Lorsque vous utilisez une application de covoiturage, confirmez le nom du conducteur, le modèle de la voiture et la plaque d'immatriculation avant de monter.
Dans les aéroports, les zones de prise en charge des taxis ou des services de covoiturage peuvent être désignées. Suivez les panneaux.
Faites attention si un inconnu vous propose une course directement à l'intérieur de l'aéroport. Il est plus sûr d'utiliser les stations de taxis officielles ou l'application.

de.heading: Vor der Fahrt: Fahrzeug und Ziel bestätigen
points: Wenn Sie eine Fahrdienst-App nutzen, bestätigen Sie vor dem Einsteigen den Namen des Fahrers, den Fahrzeugtyp und das Kennzeichen.
An Flughäfen können Taxis und Fahrdienste ausgewiesene Abholbereiche haben. Folgen Sie der Beschilderung.
Seien Sie vorsichtig, wenn Ihnen ein Fremder im Flughafen direkt eine Fahrt anbietet. Es ist sicherer, offizielle Taxistände oder die App zu nutzen.
